name: jira-acli-skill
description: Claude Code skill for working with Jira work items and Confluence via the official Atlassian CLI (acli).

plugins.name: jira-acli
plugins.description: Helps people who do not use a terminal read Jira work items, change their status, and write into Jira. Also reads Confluence pages and blog posts and can publish a blog post. Every write requires explicit human confirmation.
